name: Lucio Fulutin
source:
A zombie director brought back to "life" to direct a movie for [url=/c6510]Shinozaki Sachiko[/url]. 

Lucio's namesake is based off an Italian film director, [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lucio_Fulci]Lucio Fulci[/url], who is known as the "Godfather of Gore". However, his appearance is based off of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_A._Romero]George Andrew Romero[/url], American-Canadian film director, writer, editor and actor, regarded as an influential pioneer of the horror movie genre (zombie films in particular.)
translation:
A zombie director brought back to "life" to direct a movie for [url=/c6510]Shinozaki Sachiko[/url]. 

Lucio's namesake is based off an Italian film director, [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lucio_Fulci]Lucio Fulci[/url], who is known as the "Godfather of Gore". However, his appearance is based off of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_A._Romero]George Andrew Romero[/url], American-Canadian film director, writer, editor and actor, regarded as an influential pioneer of the horror movie genre (zombie films in particular.)
